summary: Validated P2 A→B→C→D features: Admin BioPay Vendor Diagnostics + Warning Workflows + Terminal Readiness, Merchant Portal V5 Ops Suite (Multi-Company, Document Center, Maintenance Tracker), and Arcade/Game Center Hub with Season/Leaderboard/Personal Best. All 22 backend API tests passed. All frontend UI elements verified with correct data-testid attributes.
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed datetime timezone comparison bug in _parse_iso function in merchant_portal.py - date-only strings like '2027-01-01' were returning naive datetime objects causing TypeError when compared with timezone-aware datetime.now(timezone.utc)
All new endpoints follow proper authentication patterns - admin routes require admin role, merchant routes require merchant/admin role
Ops Suite correctly auto-creates primary company from enterprise data on first access
Arcade hub-overview endpoint correctly aggregates stats, leaderboards, and personal best data

context_for_next_testing_agent: P2 features validated. Admin BioPay Audit page at /admin/biopay-audit shows vendor diagnostics, warning workflows, and terminal readiness. Merchant Ops Suite at /merchant-portal (Ops Suite tab) shows Multi-Company, Document Center, and Maintenance Tracker with CRUD operations. Gaming page at /gaming shows Arcade Hub with season stats, leaderboards, and personal best. All data-testids working correctly.
rca_of_the_issue: Fixed bug: _parse_iso function in merchant_portal.py was returning naive datetime for date-only strings (e.g., '2027-01-01'), causing TypeError when compared with timezone-aware datetime.now(timezone.utc) in _with_deadline_meta function. Fix: Added timezone.utc to naive datetime objects in _parse_iso.
